name: Red vs Blue Battle
description: Adaptive battle: the red team enters from the internet toward the file server. After each blue defense, the red team searches for an alternate path and tries again, for up to max_rounds rounds in total, until no path remains.
max_rounds_convention: max_rounds is the total number of campaign rounds, INCLUDING round 1 (the opening attack and defense). Rounds 2..max_rounds are adaptive red-team retries; the campaign never exceeds max_rounds rounds.

attack_steps.description: Red team probes the firewall from the internet
Red team reaches the DMZ web server
Red team pivots into the application server
Red team attempts to reach the file server

invariant: No path from the internet to the file server remains after adaptation rounds
